Introduction to the 2nd Circuit Courts in Maryland

The 2nd Circuit Courts in Maryland are a vital part of the state’s justice system, responsible for handling a wide range of criminal and civil cases. Located in various cities and towns across Maryland, these courts serve as an important venue for the administration of justice.

The 2nd Circuit Courts in Maryland are a type of trial court that handles both criminal and civil cases. These courts are part of the state’s circuit court system, which also includes the 1st, 3rd, 4th, and 5th Circuit Courts.
